population: All 20 VAS minute cells finite numeric within 0-10; unique ID required; no E/T imputation
shared_controller: User confirms simultaneous event commands; native TTL levels and codes need not agree

synchronization.model: fnirs_seconds = acq_seconds + offset; slope fixed 1; report fitted drift as diagnostic only
synchronization.acceptance: Unique offset with no competing offset within two matched events, sufficient span and one-to-one order-preserving matches; requires independent event identity anchor for minute labels
synchronization.dose_time: Protocol-relative timing only; no exact swallowing time inferred
synchronization.source_scope: Only current accepted subject-file mapping; other-study package is metadata evidence, not extra participants

ecg.hrv_acceptance: All raw RR within bounds; Zhao2018 excellent or barely acceptable; nonflat finite full window; no filled gaps; algorithm-screened HRV, not adjudicated clinical NN
ecg.channel_policy: Process all raw independent ECG channels; first passing channel by raw index for any downstream analysis; never select by VAS
ecg.scope: Full-record cleaning/peak detection, then complete recording-relative 300-second windows. Dose-relative interpretation requires verified event map. EGG has no dedicated validated NeuroKit2 ECG-equivalent pipeline.

association.outcome: Mean observed VAS in the corresponding 5-minute interval, 0-10
association.estimand: Exploratory within-subject concurrent association in complete-VAS subjects with aligned QC-passing windows; not causal
association.model: Subject fixed effects and categorical window time; subject-level bootstrap, 2000 replicates, seed 20260919; both exposures reported as one family
association.readiness: Unique current-record identity, verified VAS-minute event anchor and clock map, valid window/QC; otherwise output not_estimable with counts, never fake a zero effect
